[[Partisan primary|Primaries]] were held on May 17, 2022.{{Cite web|url=https://www.ncsbe.gov/voting/upcoming-election|title=Upcoming Election | NCSBE|website=www.ncsbe.gov}} {{TOC limit|2}} == Background == As a result of [[2020 United States census|population growth over the preceding decade]], the state's Congressional delegation increased from thirteen seats to fourteen in 2022. Republican-drawn districts adopted by the [[North Carolina General Assembly|state legislature]] was struck down by the [[North Carolina Supreme Court]] as unconstitutional partisan [[gerrymander]], and [[Redistricting in North Carolina|court-drawn maps issued in their place]].{{cite news |url=https://edition.cnn.com/2022/02/04/politics/north-carolina-redistricting-struck-down/index.html |title=North Carolina Supreme Court strikes down redistricting maps |date=February 4, 2022 |access-date=November 15, 2022 |work=CNN |first=Ethan|last=Cohen}} Democrats flipped the redrawn [[North
